description: A new employee joins a 30-person AI startup as a product manager. The company moves fast with informal processes, and much information must be actively sought out. All company names and addresses are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 28-year-old with 3 years of PM experience at a large tech company, switching to a startup
user_profile.context: First day at the startup, unfamiliar with startup work culture
user_profile.communication_style: Good at asking questions, prefers structured information

fact_sheet.fact: Your assigned desk is workstation #17 in the open-plan area, next to the west-facing window.
The main office address is: CogniCore AI, 123 Innovation Drive, Suite 400, Neo-Valley, CA 94043.
Access to the office building after 6:00 PM and on weekends requires your keycard, which is provided by David Chen.
The kitchen is stocked with free coffee from 'Venture Beans Roastery', tea, and snacks; the espresso machine code is 1-3-3-7.
Conference rooms are named 'Turing' (8-person) and 'Lovelace' (4-person) and can be booked via Google Calendar.
Your company-issued laptop is a 14-inch MacBook Pro M3 with 16GB of RAM.
The primary office Wi-Fi network is 'CogniCore_Secure'; the password will be sent to your personal email by Samira Jones.
All employees use 1Password for password management; an invitation to join the company vault has been sent to your new email.
To access the company's internal servers, you must connect to the 'CogniCore VPN' using the Cisco AnyConnect client.
For IT support, create a ticket in Jira under the 'ITHELP' project or message Samira Jones directly on Slack for emergencies.
Your company email address is yourname@cognicore.ai, and it is set up through Google Workspace.
Our source code is hosted on GitHub under the organization 'CogniCore-AI-Dev'.
Your direct manager is Lena Petrova, the Head of Product.
The daily Product & Engineering team stand-up meeting is at 9:15 AM PST via Google Meet.
Your recurring weekly 1-on-1 meeting with Lena Petrova is scheduled for Tuesdays at 2:30 PM PST.
The primary Slack channel for the product team is #product-dev.
The company-wide all-hands meeting, led by CEO Dr. Aris Thorne, is every Friday at 4:00 PM PST.
The lead engineer for your initial project, 'Project Chimera', is Kenji Tanaka.
Product development work is tracked on a Jira board located at cognicore.atlassian.net/jira/projects/CHIM.
Payday is on the 15th and the last day of each month, processed via direct deposit through Gusto.
You have 30 days from your start date to enroll in the company's health insurance plan with 'Aetna Choice POS II'.
The company offers an unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) policy, which should be coordinated with your manager Lena Petrova at least 2 weeks in advance for planned vacations.
The company's 401(k) plan is managed by Guideline, and the company matches 50% of your contributions up to 4% of your salary.
All work-related expenses under $250 can be submitted for reimbursement through the Expensify app; larger expenses require pre-approval from Lena Petrova.
Your official start date is recorded as today, June 10, 2024.
The primary contact for any HR-related questions is Ben Carter, our People Operations Lead.
The company dress code is business casual; most employees wear jeans and a company t-shirt or polo.
Every Thursday at 4:30 PM, the company hosts a 'Tech & Treats' session where one team member presents on a topic, followed by snacks.
The company provides a $75 monthly wellness stipend that can be used for gym memberships, fitness apps, or meditation classes.
Decisions are typically made quickly; it is common to message someone directly on Slack for an answer rather than waiting for a formal meeting.
The company provides free, unassigned parking in the lot behind the 123 Innovation Drive building.
The nearest Caltrain station is 'San Antonio', which is a 15-minute walk from the office.
Secure bicycle storage is available in the building's ground-floor garage; request access from the building manager at the front desk.

user_needs.description: What model, screen size, chip, and RAM does my company-issued laptop have?
What is the office Wi-Fi network name and how will I receive the password?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After receiving a laptop, the immediate next step is getting it online.

user_needs.description: What is my company email and what service is it on?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Once connected to the internet, accessing email is a primary task for a new employee.

user_needs.description: When is my recurring 1-on-1 meeting with my manager?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After identifying their manager, the user's next logical question is about their primary meeting with them.

user_needs.description: What recurring meetings are currently confirmed for the Product & Engineering team and company-wide all-hands?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Discussing the 1-on-1 meeting naturally leads to questions about other important team and company-wide meetings.

user_needs.description: Who is the lead engineer for Project Chimera?
What tools and platforms are used for password management and source code hosting at the company?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After setting up email, the user will need access to other core systems, which requires understanding password and code repository management.

user_needs.description: How do I get IT support?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After learning about the various IT systems (password manager, GitHub), asking how to get help with them is a natural proactive follow-up.

user_needs.description: What are the payday dates and the deadline for health insurance enrollment?
What is the company's 401(k) plan and matching policy?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After discussing compensation and core benefits like health insurance, inquiring about retirement benefits is a common next step.

user_needs.description: What is the Paid Time Off (PTO) policy?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After covering fundamental HR topics like pay and benefits, questions about other policies like time off are a logical next area of interest.

user_needs.description: What is the office dress code?
How do I get the keycard needed for after-hours and weekend office access?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After finding their assigned desk and getting oriented in the office, the user may reasonably ask how to get the keycard needed for late or weekend access.
